relevance_rank_note: Tests B2 and the dissociation-rescue arm of H4 with a clean genetic tool: ApoE4 blocks Apoer2 and glutamate receptor surface recycling more than ApoE3, and germline NHE6/Slc9a6 knockout, which acidifies the early endosome away from the ApoE4 isoelectric point to force dissociation, abolishes the block; binding itself is not measured here.

description: Surface biotinylation after Reelin treatment in wildtype (Slc9a6+) primary neurons: ApoE4-conditioned media reduced surface Apoer2 far more than ApoE3 did, reproducing the ApoE4 recycling block on an NHE6-intact background.
quote: Receptor surface levels show a stronger reduction with ApoE4 than ApoE3
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less surface Apoer2 after Reelin-induced endocytosis)
system: Mouse primary neurons from Slc9a6 wildtype embryos (Slc9a6+/+ and Slc9a6y/+ littermates); naturally secreted receptor-binding competent human ApoE3 or ApoE4 conditioned media 30 min, then Reelin 30 min; sulfo-NHS-SS-biotin surface biotinylation, normalised surface/total Apoer2 by immunoblot
human_check: Fig 4C Slc9a6+ bars read off the image: C+R 100, E3+R ~78, E4+R ~27, so E4 sits ~51 percentage points below E3. Please confirm. Only one bracket is drawn in panel C, control-to-E4 (***), with no E3-vs-E4 bracket, so no P is recorded for this row's contrast. Legend says n = three independent experiments but four points are plotted per bar in C; I kept the printed n=3 rather than the point count. NOTE the legend's key here is '***p < 0.005', not the more usual 0.001.

description: The same assay run on neurons from Slc9a6 (NHE6) knockout littermates, where early endosomes are more acidic and ApoE4 should dissociate from its receptors: ApoE4 no longer reduced surface Apoer2, and the smaller ApoE3 effect was abolished too.
quote: Apoer2 recycling was completely restored in Slc9a6- neurons treated with ApoE4
summary: (APOE4 + NHE6 knockout forcing dissociation) -> (surface Apoer2 restored to control level)
system: Mouse primary neurons from germline Slc9a6 knockout embryos (Slc9a6-/- and Slc9a6y/- littermates of the wildtypes in the same panel); naturally secreted human ApoE3 or ApoE4 conditioned media 30 min, then Reelin 30 min; surface biotinylation, normalised surface/total Apoer2
human_check: Class 2: surrogate perturbation of A (genetic NHE6 loss acidifies the EE to force ApoE4 off its receptor) with recycling measured. In the Slc9a6- half of Fig 4C all three bars sit at ~95-100 with no stars and no brackets drawn, so this is a restored-to-control null with no defensible magnitude or P. The dissociation mechanism is the authors' interpretation, stated in the abstract, not measured in this panel.

description: In the same experiment the NMDA receptor subunit GluN2B, co-endocytosed with Apoer2, showed the same pattern: ApoE4 reduced its surface level more than ApoE3 in wildtype neurons, and NHE6 knockout restored it. Effect detail: GluA1 (Fig 4E) and GluA2/3 (Fig 4F) behave the same way in the same figure.
quote: genetic loss of NHE6 equally restored the ApoE4-impaired surface expression of AMPA and NMDA receptor subunits
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less surface GluN2B as co-trafficked cargo); rescued by NHE6 knockout
system: Mouse primary neurons from Slc9a6 wildtype and knockout littermate embryos; naturally secreted human ApoE3 or ApoE4 conditioned media 30 min, then Reelin 30 min; surface biotinylation, normalised surface/total GluN2B
human_check: Row scoped to Fig 4D (GluN2B) only, per one-panel-per-row; the sister panels are noted in the description, and if they are wanted as evidence they need their own rows. Bars read off the image in the Slc9a6+ half of 4D: C+R 100, E3+R ~75, E4+R ~26, so ~49 points. For reference GluA1 (4E) is E3 ~76 vs E4 ~35 and GluA2/3 (4F) is E3 ~78 vs E4 ~31. Please confirm the 4D reading. Lower relevance and strength because glutamate receptors are co-trafficked cargo, not ApoE-binding recycling receptors, so this is one step further from B. Brackets in 4D are control-to-E3 (*) and control-to-E4 (***); no E3-vs-E4 bracket.
